text:
Convert files without uploading them. Keep your documents, photos, music, and videos on your own computer. 

 

 Offline File Converter for Windows is a free, open-source desktop application for converting PDF files, documents, images, audio, and video in one convenient place. Designed for Windows 10 and Windows 11, it combines an intuitive graphical interface, batch processing, and private local conversion without requiring command-line knowledge or cloud uploads.

 ⬇️ Installation

 Download the Windows application 

1. Open the repository's Releases page.
2. Download the latest release archive Offline File Converter for Windows 4.1.3.zip .
3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice.
4. Keep Offline File Converter for Windows 4.1.3.exe and libvlc.dll together in that folder.
5. Double-click Offline File Converter for Windows 4.1.3.exe to launch the application.

 ✨ Features

- 📄 PDF and Document Converter – Convert supported document formats and PDF files directly from your Windows desktop.
- 🖼️ Image Format Converter – Transform images between supported formats for sharing, editing, archiving, and everyday use.
- 🎵 Audio Converter – Process supported audio files with convenient format conversion options.
- 🎬 Video Converter – Convert supported video formats locally without uploading large media files to online services.
- 📦 Batch File Conversion – Select multiple files and process them through one streamlined conversion workflow.
- 🔒 100% Offline File Conversion – Keep your files on your computer instead of sending personal documents to conversion websites.
- 🎨 Dark and Light Themes – Choose a comfortable interface appearance for different environments and preferences.
- 📊 Conversion Statistics Dashboard – Review conversion activity and explore usage statistics through an integrated dashboard.
- 🏆 Achievements and Progress – Make everyday file management more engaging with built-in achievements.
- ⚙️ Multi-Engine Fallback – Use an adaptable conversion architecture designed to handle different file types and available processing engines.

 🖼️ Overview

 

The application brings everyday file conversion tasks together in one Windows desktop interface.

Whether you need to convert a PDF, prepare images for another application, change an audio format, or process a collection of files, the goal is the same: make conversion straightforward, accessible, and private.

 Supported conversion categories

 Category Common use cases 
 --- --- 
 Documents Document format conversion 
 PDF PDF-related conversion workflows 
 Images Image format conversion 
 Audio Audio format conversion 
 Video Video format conversion 
 Multiple files Batch processing 

 Available input and output formats depend on the installed conversion engines and their capabilities. 

 🚀 Usage

Getting started is designed to be simple, even if you have never used a file conversion utility before.

1. Open the application – Launch the Offline File Converter from your Windows desktop.
2. Choose your files – Browse for files or use the available file selection workflow.
3. Select a conversion type – Choose the appropriate conversion category and available output format.
4. Configure your task – Adjust the available conversion options.
5. Start conversion – Run the conversion locally and let the application process your files.
6. Find your results – Access the converted files from your selected output location.

 Tips for better conversions

- Use batch processing when converting several files of the same type.
- Keep sufficient free disk space available for large media conversions.
- Choose an output format compatible with the application or device where you intend to use the converted file.
- Keep your original files until you have verified the converted results.
- Use the theme settings to customize your working environment.

 🪟 Built for Windows

The application is designed as a native-style Windows desktop experience using Python and PySide6.

 Component Details 
 --- --- 
 Operating system Windows 10 / Windows 11 
 Architecture 64-bit Windows 
 Programming language Python 
 Desktop framework PySide6 / Qt 
 Interface Graphical desktop application 
 Conversion Local processing 
 Network requirement No internet required for offline conversion 

No terminal commands are needed for normal application use.

 🔐 Privacy and Offline Processing

Your files deserve to stay private.

This application is designed around local file processing rather than browser-based conversion services.

- No cloud uploads: Your files are processed on your computer.
- No conversion website: You do not need to upload documents to an external service.
- No telemetry or tracking: The application is designed without usage-tracking telemetry.
- No mandatory internet connection: Core offline conversion workflows are intended to work without an internet connection.
- Local data: Conversion statistics and application-related information are maintained locally.
- Open-source transparency: The source code can be inspected and audited.

For sensitive documents, confidential business files, personal photographs, and private media, offline processing provides an alternative to uploading content to third-party conversion websites.

 🖥️ Interface and Productivity

 A clean desktop experience

The graphical interface is designed to make file conversion approachable without sacrificing useful functionality.

 Personalization

Switch between dark and light themes to match your Windows desktop environment.

 Activity dashboard

Explore conversion statistics and activity information through the integrated dashboard.

 Achievements

Built-in achievements add a lightweight progress element to everyday conversion tasks.

 Flexible conversion engines

The multi-engine fallback architecture provides an adaptable foundation for handling different conversion categories and processing requirements.
